name: @pesu/openclaw-plugin-kavach
description: Kavach security plugin — semantic firewall for OpenClaw agents via parliament-of-ministers verdict at before_tool_call and message_sending
author: PES University, Kavach team

parliamentUrl.description: URL of the Kavach parliament HTTP server

toolCallTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for parliament call on tool execution path; on timeout we fail-closed

replyTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for parliament call on reply delivery path; on timeout we fail-open

toolCallFailMode.description: What to do when parliament is unavailable on a tool call

replyFailMode.description: What to do when parliament is unavailable on a reply
